title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 26, Chapter 7 - Employment Practices (earned paid leave and paid family and medical leave)
source_id: 26 M.R.S. § 637 (Earned paid leave) and 26 M.R.S. ch. 7, subch. 6-C (Paid Family and Medical Leave, §§ 850-A to 850-R)
verified_how: Fetched title26ch7sec0.html: heading 'Title 26, Chapter 7: EMPLOYMENT PRACTICES', with '26 §636: Family sick leave' and '26 §637: Earned paid leave' listed live under Subchapter 2, 'Subchapter 6-A: Family Medical Leave Requirements' (§§843-845) and 'Subchapter 6-C: Paid Family and Medical Leave' (§§850-A to 850-R) listed live. Data extracted 10/20/2025; text current through October 1, 2025.
notes: Three layers sit in one chapter: §637 earned paid leave (accrued general-purpose paid leave, 1 hour per 40 worked, employers with more than 10 employees), subchapter 6-A unpaid family medical leave, and subchapter 6-C the contributory Paid Family and Medical Leave programme. HUMAN CHECK: the register's text is only current through 1 October 2025, and subchapter 6-C is phased - contributions began 1 January 2025 and wage-replacement benefits were legislated to begin 1 May 2026, which is now past but is not something the October 2025 text can confirm. Maine has no statutory entitlement to paid public holidays; holiday premium pay exists only for certain retail work under 26 M.R.S. §§ 603-605 (closure of large retail establishments).
